node.statement: The inverse (u_delta,h_delta) in 1.4 is C^1 and therefore continuous on S_delta. The affine map (t,U_0,U_1) mapsto (1-t)U_0+tU_1 is jointly continuous, and 1.5 places its value in S_delta throughout the admissible parameter domain. Therefore H(t,U_0,U_1):=u_delta((1-t)U_0+tU_1) is jointly continuous in (t,U_0,U_1).
